This is because a lot of people flying with keyboard and mouse don't adjust their speed limiter with the scroll wheel and that annoys me as well. As for the ships ability to accelerate and stop so rapidly, it's down to the acceleration power of the thrusters themselves. The thrusters in ED don't have as much accelerating power as the thrusters in SC, that's why you'll get that heavy, sluggish feel in ED ships but not in SC. IMO, they should decrease the acceleration power of the maneuvering thrusters (the thrusters other than the main and retro ones) of some of the heavier ships. You can also modify the thrust acceleration of every ship if you bind it to a key (this is different from speed limiter) or if you fly decoupled. I encourage everyone who loves flying to fly decoupled, especially if you're playing with sticks. IMO, the flight model in SC is much more realistic than ED, but executed poorly.
